provider_acquisition_order: GUM_V1 metadata/schema then bounded official component
PELLETIER_ORNL_1304 metadata only; sample only if <=100MB
SOILGRIDS_2_0 official stable alternative metadata only
pre5b_sample_strategy: deterministic documented/provider-supplied cases covering mapped, outside-coverage, lithology, thickness and water/ice/nodata branches; do not hand-pick for outcomes
hash_policy: compute ARCANA SHA256 after acquisition; PRE5-A values remain NOT_ACQUIRED
archive_extraction_policy: inspect manifest first; extract only selected members into excluded raw cache
crs_inspection_policy: read declared CRS and fail closed if absent or ambiguous
format_inspection_policy: identify format and parser before derivation
schema_inspection_policy: record fields, nodata and coverage without remapping
failure_behavior: fail closed; preserve UNKNOWN, OUTSIDE_SOURCE_COVERAGE and CONFLICTING_SOURCES
credential_policy: never store credentials; use provider environment/auth mechanism only in PRE5-B
git_exclusion_policy: no scientific payloads, caches or arrays in Git
cleanup_policy: retain metadata manifest; remove failed/incomplete payloads from cache
repeatability_policy: record DOI/version, resolved URL, timestamp, relevant headers, checksum, tool and extraction member
